items.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: he made me a beautiful seven string and he also made me a beautiful acoustic seven string

ctx.x: No, I mean the specific brand of guitar.

Oh, okay, well for the last five, five and a half years I’ve been playing a guitar made by Benedetto, Bob Benedetto. He’s a guitar maker. He’s been making guitars for about thirty years now. He’s located in Pennsylvania. And he just makes hand made archtop guitars basically. And when I made the switch to seven strings, since you can’t really go out into the music store and buy one that easily, he made me a beautiful seven string and he also made me a beautiful acoustic seven string, with no pick-up just dry. And…
Does the seven string require some re-learning for you?
